description: When the open tickets, or a number of them, will be done at the pace the project actually had: a Monte Carlo simulation replays days drawn at random from the last historyDays (how many tickets were done on each), 10000 times, and gives the number of days and the date by which the tickets are done in 50, 85 and 95% of the runs. It counts tickets, not their size, and assumes the coming weeks look like the recent ones. No outcomes when no ticket was done in the history. For "how much fits into N points of capacity" use plan_capacity instead.

historyDays.description: Days of recent pace to go by (default 90)

items.description: Tickets to forecast (default: the open ones, not state:done)

name: report_forecast

days.description: Days from today; null when not within ten years

likelihood.description: Percent of the runs done by then
